## Summary

Describe the user-facing or operational outcome of this change.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (when the change affects a user journey)
- [ ] I tested the affected locale(s), viewport(s), and accessibility behavior where relevant.

## Review checklist

- [ ] This pull request has one clear purpose and links to its issue or approved request.
- [ ] I added or updated automated tests when behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, customer data, order data, or unlicensed assets.
- [ ] I kept real pricing, inventory, payments, fulfilment, policies, and business-contact changes behind explicit owner approval.
- [ ] I documented any rollout, rollback, migration, or follow-up needed below.

## Screenshots or recording

Include before/after evidence for visual or responsive changes. Remove any sensitive information first.

## Risk and rollout

State the risk, deployment notes, rollback plan, and any owner approval required. Write `None` when not applicable.
